english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for severe torment or suffering, especially when someone is being put through it.
Use 折磨 when the thing is experienced as a severe torment, especially physical harm.

examples.english: The constant pain from this illness is torment for me.
This headache is hell—it keeps me from sleeping.
examples.traditional: 呢種頭痛真係折磨，搞到我瞓唔到。
